tracks.title: Two cafés compared

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: このカフェは静かですね。
turns.english: This café is quiet, isn't it?

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: はい。でも、駅の前のカフェはにぎやかです。
turns.english: Yes. But the café in front of the station is lively.

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: ここのコーヒーはおいしいですか。

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: はい、おいしいです。でも、ケーキはあまりおいしくないです。
turns.english: Yes, it is. But the cake isn't very tasty.

comprehensionPrompts: How is the café near the station described?
What does the speaker think of the cake?

tracks.title: Choosing between two bags

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: この赤いかばんは大きいですね。
turns.english: This red bag is big, isn't it?

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: はい。でも、少し高いです。
turns.english: Yes. But it's a little expensive.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: あの青いかばんはどうですか。

turns.speaker: female
turns.text: 青いかばんは大きくないです。でも、安くて便利です。
turns.english: The blue bag isn't big. But it's inexpensive and convenient.

turns.speaker: male
turns.text: じゃあ、青いかばんにします。
turns.english: Then I'll take the blue bag.

comprehensionPrompts: What two qualities describe the blue bag?
Which bag does the shopper choose?
